category_title: Students with severe hearing impairment and EAL who use physical gestures and lip-reading to decipher archaic language
scenario_title: Rehearsing and reading aloud with pronunciation difficulties
minimal_context: The student is rehearsing a script aloud for an upcoming drama performance.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's practice reading your script aloud for the final performance.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Enthusiastically gets into character, putting his hand to his ear) I hear... (Uses pointing and punching actions while reading, having great difficulty pronouncing the words)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good effort. Make sure you pronounce the 's' sounds at the end of the words.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Perseveres and continues reading aloud with confidence, still missing the 's' sounds)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You missed the 's' sounds again. Please listen to my suggestion and try to fix your pronunciation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the suggestions completely, acting as though he is doing it right, and continues reading his lines undeterred)

context.social_setting: with support from a Teaching Assistant (TA)
context.time_context: lead up to his final performance

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: having great difficulty with pronouncing words and missing ‘s’ sounds
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: thought he was doing it right

behavior_patterns.condition: reading aloud to the class in every lesson
